# files.StoredFile

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A file uploaded by a member, validated by content before agents or the knowledge base can read it.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `files.StoredFile` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |

| `contentType` | yes | `none` | Media type detected from the bytes once ready; declared type before. |  |

| `status` | yes | `none` | pending until the upload is validated. |  |
| `storagePath` | yes | `none` | Object path, tenants/{tenantId}/files/{fileId}. |  |

| `updatedAt` | yes | `none` | When the file last changed (UTC). |  |
